Note:
In pursuance to Section 115BAA of the Income Tax Act, 1961 notified by the Government of India through Taxation Laws (Amendment) Ordinance, 2019, the
Company had an irrevocable option of shifting to a lower tax rate foregoing other tax incentives. The Company excercised the said option for lower rates of taxes
and deferred tax assets and liabilities has been measured accordingly. The applicable rate for the current year is 25.168% (previous year 34.944%). The impact of
such change in rate of taxes on the deferred tax as on 31.03.2021 is ₹345.15 crore.
